'''Cormit''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Cormit was located near the border of the Ascendancy's core territory in the [[Cormit system/Legends|Cormit system]] and at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], the [[Vagaari Corridor]] and the [[Phalanx Route]]. The planet was the location of one of the two major [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] bases.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cormit first appeared in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]]. Said reference book placed Cormit in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
